name: pulsar-flutter
description: Dart and Flutter support for the Pulsar editor: syntax highlighting, LSP diagnostics/autocomplete, run/debug, hot reload, and device management.

dartSdkPath.title: Dart SDK Path
dartSdkPath.description: Path to the Dart SDK root. Leave empty to resolve `dart` from PATH.

flutterSdkPath.title: Flutter SDK Path
flutterSdkPath.description: Path to the Flutter SDK root. Leave empty to resolve `flutter` from PATH.

useFvm.title: Use FVM
useFvm.description: Resolve Dart/Flutter binaries through FVM (Flutter Version Management) when available.

formatOnSave.title: Format on Save
formatOnSave.description: Run `dart format` via the LSP formatter on save.

codeActionsOnFormat.title: Code Actions on Format
codeActionsOnFormat.description: LSP code actions to apply on format/save.
